techStack: Express 5.2.1 (direct usage, no wrapper) mounted at /api/products prefix in app.ts
TypeScript 6.0.2, pnpm, tsx watch for dev, vitest 4.1.5 for tests (pnpm test runs vitest run)
Zod 4.4.3 for validation via custom validate() middleware factory applied per-route: router.get(path, validate(schema), handler)
validate() middleware calls schema.safeParse() on params+query, returns 400 with field errors on failure, attaches result to req.validated
Middleware stack order: requestId → rateLimiter → cors → express.json() → route-level requireAuth (not on /api/products routes) → error handler
No auth guard on apiProductRoutes — compare and getById routes are public
features: GET /api/products/:id → productController.getById, validated by productIdSchema (string, min 1, max 100 chars)
GET /api/products/compare → compareController.compare, validated by compareQuerySchema (ids: comma-separated, split into array, min 2 max 3 required)
compare response shape: { products: Product[], count: number } where count equals products.length
compareService throws ValidationError (400) for: fewer than 2 IDs, more than 3 IDs, duplicate IDs, or non-existent product ID
productController.getById throws ProductNotFoundError (404) when product not found
Must-not-regress: all 3 compare.test.ts assertions and all 16 products.test.ts assertions (products.test.ts tests /products with auth, not /api/products)
architecture: src/ layout: controllers/, routes/, services/, data/, db/, middleware/, schemas/, types/, errors/, utils/, app.ts, server.ts
Data flow: routes → controllers → services → db/data layer
BUG — current registration order in apiProductRoutes.ts: (1) router.get('/:id', ...) then (2) router.get('/compare', ...)
Express matches routes in registration order: /:id intercepts /compare requests (id='compare'), which then 404s because no product has id='compare'
Fix: swap the two router.get() calls so /compare is registered before /:id
No other files need changes — compareController, productController, compareService, and productSchema must remain unmodified per requirement 6
edgeCases: Zero or one ID in ?ids=: Zod schema .min(2) rejects before controller, returns 400 — already handled, no code change needed
Missing ?ids param entirely: schema field is required (no .optional()), returns 400 — already handled
Non-existent product ID in compare list: compareService throws ValidationError('Product not found: {id}') → 400
/:id with non-existent numeric product: productController passes ProductNotFoundError to error handler → 404 — must not regress after route swap
/:id with 'compare' as id (string): after fix, Express never reaches /:id for /compare path — degenerate case eliminated by correct route order
Hidden tests directory (src/tests/hidden/) exists but is currently empty — no additional hidden test constraints discovered

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 — GET /api/products/compare must return 200/400 correctly, and fix must be confined to src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts only
tasks.description: In src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts, swap the registration order of the two route handlers so that router.get('/compare', validate(compareQuerySchema), compare) appears before router.get('/:id', validate(productIdSchema), getById). This ensures Express matches the static /compare path before the dynamic /:id parameter, fixing the 404 bug without touching any controller, service, or schema file.
